# PDF Section

> Free, private online PDF tools. Every file is processed locally in the browser; nothing is uploaded to a server.

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfsection.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one
- [Split PDF](https://pdfsection.com/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate files
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfsection.com/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size
- [Convert PDF](https://pdfsection.com/convert-pdf): PDF to Word, Excel, JPG, PowerPoint and back
- [Edit PDF](https://pdfsection.com/edit-pdf): Edit text and images in a PDF
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfsection.com/sign-pdf): Add signatures to a PDF
- [Protect PDF](https://pdfsection.com/protect-pdf): Password-protect a PDF

## Information
- [About](https://pdfsection.com/about): Who builds PDF Section and why
- [Privacy](https://pdfsection.com/privacy): 100% client-side processing, no file logging
- [Blog](https://pdfsection.com/blog): PDF security and privacy guides
